The repeatable semantic journey uses a public-profile Creator and stops before duplicate submission; separate browser cases exercise private-profile prerequisites, same-source and selected Environment-version return, and mobile visibility. Other SC-07A browser cases exercise actual Effect, Composition, Scene and Environment submission, moderation, listing, installation, immutable updates, refusal and recovery. Validated local animation tracks remain in the package; placed reusable assets without verified source licenses and pinned package dependencies are refused. Installed Asset and Composition Scene copies require modification rights on the exact pinned release; a saved Asset without a generated reusable marker is accepted only after server verification of its Library classification, source checksum and self-contained content. Private Composition extraction retains reuse lineage and self-contained Asset export refuses placed-source content. Browser evidence does not establish owner acceptance or real room safety.

Phase 2 target selection, Phase 3 manipulation and Crossdeck Air Handoff are not implemented by this laboratory.
